items.title: Anthropic publishes first R&D Automation Index: Claude leads 26% of internal AI research
items.body: Anthropic released three public metrics tracking AI self-improvement inside frontier labs. Claude leads 26% of Anthropic AI R&D work as of August 2026 (up from under 1% in February), with over 90% at or above collaboration level and zero fully autonomous subsets. Approximately 30,000 agents run concurrently; ~6% of R&D compute goes to safety. The post invites other labs to publish identical measures and supports third-party verification for pacing proposals.

items.title: Anthropic opens Life Sciences Verification Program for Mythos access
items.body: New LSVP grants life-science teams verified access to Mythos, Opus and Sonnet with relaxed biology safeguards under shared-responsibility monitoring. Standard Use for most research; High-risk Use for dual-use projects. Applications open; aims to enable drug discovery while retaining offline misuse detection and 30-day data retention.

items.title: Claude optimizes 30+ open-source biomolecular models 4× faster; protein design competition launched
items.body: Anthropic Science Blog details Claude-written custom GPU software that cut inference latency for open-source molecular models by average 4×. Code open-sourced. Partnership with Adaptyv Bio validates >5,000 designs; Anthropic supplies up to $1 M Claude credits plus funding, Modal compute, Twist DNA.

items.title: OpenAI launches Astra for Law
items.body: OpenAI introduced Astra for Law, combining its Astra model with a US case-law index, statutes and specialized legal instructions. Initially available to selected firms via Trusted Access in ChatGPT and Codex; API access forthcoming.
